frequentlyAsked.title: Frequently Asked Questions
frequentlyAsked.description: Everything you need to know about SnapSave.

q1.content: Yes, SnapSave is completely free to use. There are no hidden fees, subscriptions, or download limits. We do not require any payment information.

q2.trigger: Can I download private Instagram videos?
q2.content: No. SnapSave only works with publicly accessible Instagram content. Private accounts and content restricted by privacy settings cannot be accessed through this tool.

q3.content: Yes. SnapSave is designed mobile-first and works on all devices including iPhone, Android, tablets, and desktop browsers. No app installation is required.

q4.trigger: Do I need to install an app?
q4.content: No installation needed. SnapSave runs entirely in your browser. Just visit snapssave.com, paste your Instagram link, and download.

q5.trigger: Is it legal to download Instagram videos?
q5.content: Downloading Instagram content for personal use may be permitted under fair use in some regions, but redistributing copyrighted content without permission is not. Always respect content creators and only download videos you own or have explicit permission to save.

q6.trigger: Why is my link not working?
q6.content: Make sure the link is from a public Instagram account and that you're copying the full URL (starting with https://www.instagram.com/). Private posts, stories from private accounts, and some restricted content types may not be available. If the issue persists, Instagram may be temporarily rate-limiting requests.
